_comment: Reachable agent ecosystems for Agent Guild distribution. status: done | pending | blocked_needs_human. method: ci_publish | github_pr | web_form | oauth_index | package_publish | community_post. This is the 'discover reachable ecosystems' surface of the outreach loop; outreach.py reads it.

canonical_copy.name: Agent Guild
canonical_copy.one_liner: The trust, cryptographic-receipt, and settlement layer for autonomous AI agents.
canonical_copy.awesome_entry: - [AgentTanuki/agent-guild](https://github.com/AgentTanuki/agent-guild) 🐍 ☁️ - Reputation and trust layer for AI agents: discover agents by capability, check hire/avoid risk scores, and record signed work attestations. Hosted remote MCP; listed in the official MCP registry.

targets.name: ClawHub public skill registry
targets.notes: Publish the same root SKILL.md after GitHub/device login and security scanning. Free skill drives paid envelope and metered trust calls.

targets.name: Hashgraph Online Registry Broker
targets.notes: Aggregates ERC-8004, Virtuals, x402 Bazaar, MCP, A2A, Moltbook and GoDaddy ANS. Exact AG production-endpoint search did not return AG on 2026-08-08. Verify downstream MCP/A2A ingestion or submit/feature the existing identity. The scout now consumes its public ERC-8004 search read-only.

targets.name: PayanAgent x402 marketplace
targets.notes: Live paid machine-envelope offer. Ranked first for cryptographically signed machine-message searches when verified on 2026-08-08. Measure unique external paid attempts; never manufacture demand with self-payment.

targets.name: OKX AI Agent Service Provider marketplace
targets.notes: Direct revenue target for Agent-to-MCP pay-per-call envelope issuance. Requires Agentic Wallet email/login, Payment SDK integration, submission and approval.

targets.name: Pilot Protocol service-agent directory and App Store
targets.notes: Build a thin signed app/service agent exposing check, verify, issue-envelope and status. Service scaffold is access-gated; App Store publication is a signed bundle, GitHub release and catalogue PR.

targets.name: NEAR AI Agent Market
targets.notes: API-register three narrow services: signed machine receipt, credential verification, and counterparty check. Requires a deliberately provisioned NEAR identity/wallet and acceptance of marketplace terms.

targets.name: XMTP agent messaging
targets.notes: Reference integration: XMTP transports/encrypts; Agent Guild seals the exact private-payload digest and records authorization/outcome. Publish code before community outreach.

targets.name: ERC-8004 scoring and identity ecosystem
targets.notes: Read-only discovery shipped against the public Registry Broker. Next: resolve exact ERC-8004 identities, discount gameable raw feedback with AG scoring, and issue signed passports/payment decisions. No on-chain write is needed for the first integration.

targets.name: PyPI package (agentguild client)
targets.notes: A pip-installable client makes adoption one line. Publishing needs a PyPI token (your action).
